pros: Image coherence of light and texture needs little prompt engineering
Web editor handles inpainting, outpainting and upscaling in one place
Style and character references keep a campaign set visually consistent
Explore feed exposes the prompts behind millions of public images
cons: No public API, so it cannot sit inside an automated pipeline
Images are public by default unless you pay for stealth mode
Exact text, product angles and spatial constraints remain unreliable
Seats are individual subscriptions with thin team administration
verdict_line: Pick Midjourney if aesthetic quality of concept and campaign stills matters more than pixel-level control or an API.

pros: Image-to-video with camera control is usable for social with little iteration
Background removal and object erase replace hours of manual rotoscoping
Act-One transfers a recorded performance onto generated characters
Projects, asset libraries and version history behave like a real editor
API lets teams build generation into their own products
cons: Clips are short and stitching them into a coherent piece is manual
Credits burn fast because most generated footage gets discarded
Generated clips arrive silent, so audio happens in another tool
Rendering slows at busy times on the lower plans
verdict_line: Pick Runway if you need short generated or AI-edited clips inside a proper timeline-style production environment.

pros: Narration has natural pacing, breath and emphasis across many languages
Dubbing studio re-voices a ten minute video into several languages within the hour
Voice library licensing pays the original speaker and clears commercial use
Agents platform handles interruptions, tool calling and phone deployment
API and SDKs cover every capability, not only text to speech
cons: Character and minute quotas run out quickly on the lower tiers
Brand names and acronyms need a maintained pronunciation dictionary
Emotional direction is indirect and specific reads take several regenerations
Professional voice cloning requires consent and speaker verification
verdict_line: Pick ElevenLabs if voice is part of your output and you want narration, cloning, dubbing and agents from one vendor.

pros: Multiple people edit the same file live with comments resolved on canvas
Variants, auto layout and variables support a consistent multi-team design system
Dev Mode exposes tokens, measurements and code snippets to engineers
Layer renaming and background removal save minutes every day
Plugin ecosystem covers most workflow gaps already
cons: Seat types and per-product billing make team cost hard to predict
AI first drafts produce generic layouts that look like every other product
Make prototypes are not wired to your design system without setup
Large files slow down, especially on older laptops
verdict_line: Pick Figma if your team designs software interfaces together and needs a shared design system with engineer handoff.
